scope: Proposition 7.8 (Reduction to bounded Dobrushin problems) of the manuscript “Thermal FK–Ising interfaces and massive SLE” (preprints/Thermal-FK-Ising-interfaces-and-massive-SLE-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2a2a4a8b4213752), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 48. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: From every admissible approxi- mation sequence one can extract a further subsequence and perform finite edge revelations with success probability tending to one, so that on success: 1. the unqueried connecting domain b Ωn is a Dobrushin polygon on the original mesh with the same thermal parameters and diameter at most 2S + 20; 2. conditional on the complete revelation record, its interface has the ordinary Dobrushin FK law; 3. every deterministic sequence of possible successful outputs (b Ωn, b an,b bn) converges in the marked Carathéodory sense to (Ω, a, b); 4. the normalized coordinates on the retained domain are uniformly o(1) from its original normalized coordinates, including prime-end occurrences, and the removed endpoint heads have vanishing disc diameter. All error bounds are uniform over successful outcomes.
